description: Verify that clientServiceActivate spawns FindService for SERVICE-ID-2 while preserving SERVICE-ID-1 server
approach:
[Objective]
Mixed-role: DUT is both server (SID-1) and client (SID-2). Activating client mode for SID-2 emits FindService without disturbing SID-1's offer.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService for SID-1.
2. Tester (UT) → DUT: clientServiceActivate for SID-2.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: FindService for SID-2.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT followed client-mode FindService rule — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_findservice: No DUT FindService for SERVICE-ID-2 within listen window
